recognize_zh: 單顆中型細胞，高核質比、染色質細緻、胞質只有一圈嗜鹼性邊緣，形態為母細胞（blast）；JMML 周邊血可見少量母細胞（通常 <20%）。
features: Single medium-sized mononuclear cell with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly angulated nucleus with fine, open chromatin
Thin rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Adjacent large platelet; red cells with occasional crenated forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized mononuclear cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine open chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm, consistent with a circulating blast. No Auer rods are seen. A large platelet is present nearby. In the setting of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, occasional circulating blasts are expected, but a blast count of 20% or more would indicate transformation to acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia (e.g., with monosomy 7 or acute myelomonocytic)
ddx.vs: AML requires ≥20% blasts/promonocytes in blood or marrow, whereas JMML has fewer blasts with monocytosis.
Lymphoblasts may look identical; flow cytometry for TdT, CD34, CD19/CD3 and myeloid markers is needed.
